name: FMC in a Gem City Temple 2023

venue.name: Hindu Temple of Dayton
venue.details: Competition is through the back entrance.

information: This competition will be taking place inside a Hindu Temple. No outside food is to be brought onto the premises. Lunch and snacks will be provided, see Food tab for more information. Competitors not competing in Fewest Moves should plan to arrive between 12pm and 12:30pm.
